description: An uploaded file can be read back with the /api/read endpoint. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. In one eval: POST to /api/upload with fetch a multipart form (FormData) whose field "file" is a file named "readable.txt" of type text/plain containing "hello from test"; take the path from the response's JSON; then GET /api/read?path= followed by encodeURIComponent of that path; and return JSON.stringify({upload: <the upload response's status>, read: <the read response's status>, text: <the read response's text>}). It must be exactly {"upload":200,"read":200,"text":"hello from test"}.

steps.expression: (async function() { const fd = new FormData(); const file = new File(['hello from test'], 'readable.txt', {type: 'text/plain'}); fd.append('file', file); const uploadRes = await fetch('/api/upload', {method: 'POST', body: fd}); const uploadJson = await uploadRes.json(); const path = uploadJson.path; const readRes = await fetch('/api/read?path=' + encodeURIComponent(path)); const readText = await readRes.text(); return JSON.stringify({upload: uploadRes.status, read: readRes.status, text: readText}); })()
